cohort: 18,093 women admitted for delivery at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Fondazione Policlinico Universitario 'A Gemelli' IRCCS, Rome, Italy, between 2012-2016
finding: Minority ethnic groups experience higher rates of complications during birth and consequently incur increased healthcare costs compared to Caucasian women.
mod_finding: The highest cesarean section (CS) rates were observed among Maghreb (51.5%) and Afro-Caribbean (47.8%) women.
